mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Reign of Anger</titleLeft><mainText>Renekton is furious, watch out!</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

<titleLeft>Form of the Tyrant</titleLeft><mainText>Renekton has bonus Health and gains Fury periodically. Nearby enemies take magic damage per second.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
<titleLeft>Fury</titleLeft><mainText>Renekton has enough Fury for an empowered attack.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Renekton swings his blade, dealing moderate physical damage to all targets around him, and heals for a small portion of the damage dealt. If he has more than 50 Fury, his damage and heal are increased.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Renekton swings his blade, dealing @BasicDamage@ physical damage and restoring @NonChampHealing@ Health per non-champion and @ChampHealing@ per champion hit. He also generates @MinionFuryGain@ Fury per non-champion and @ChampionFuryGain@ Fury per champion.

Fury Bonus: Damage is increased to @EmpDamage@ physical damage and healing is increased to @EmpNonChampHealing@ Health against non-champions and @EmpChampHealing@ Health against champions. Does not generate any Fury.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine:
Max @FuryGainCap@ Fury per cast.
Restores up to @BasicHealCap@ Health on basic casts.
Restores up to @EmpoweredHealCap@ Health on empowered casts.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Ruthless Predator</titleLeft><mainText>Renekton's next attack will hit multiple times and stun his target.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Renekton slashes his target twice, dealing moderate physical damage and stuns them for 0.75 seconds. If Renekton has more than 50 Fury, he slashes his target three times, destroying damage shields on the target, dealing high physical damage, and stunning them for 1.5 seconds.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Renekton's next Attack strikes twice, Stunning for @StunDuration@ seconds and dealing a total of @BasicTotalDamage@ physical damage. Hitting a champion generates an additional @BonusFuryVsChamps@ Fury.

Fury Bonus: Renekton Attacks 3 times instead, destroying Shields before dealing @EmpTotalDamage@ physical damage and Stunning for @EnragedStunDuration@ seconds. Does not generate any Fury.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine:
All Attacks apply On-hit effects separately.
Does not break shields on monsters.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Renekton's attacks generate Fury, increased when he is low on life. This Fury can empower his abilities with bonus effects.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Renekton gains @FuryPerAttack@ Fury per Attack. While above @FuryCost@ Fury, his next Ability spends it to become empowered. Fury decays while out of combat.

While below @LowHealthPercentThreshold*100@% Health, Renekton gains @FuryIncreasePercent*100@% increased Fury.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Renekton transforms into the Tyrant form, gaining bonus Health and dealing damage to enemies around him. While in this form, Renekton gains Fury periodically.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Renekton surrounds himself with dark energies for @BuffDuration@ seconds, gaining <healing>@HealthGain@ max Health</healing> and <keywordMajor>@FuryOnCast@ Fury</keywordMajor>. While active, he deals <magicDamage>@TotalDamagePerSecond@ magic damage</magicDamage> and gains <keywordMajor>@FuryPerSecond@ Fury</keywordMajor> per second.

Nasus has fallen to Renekton's rage. The size Nasus gains from his Ultimate Ability, Fury of the Sands, has decreased.

“I failed Renekton, failed Shurima. The Butcher of the Sands returns in chaos and carnage.”

With Nasus' defeat, Renekton's Ultimate Ability, Dominus, now lasts longer and grants additional size.

“That dog is no brother of mine. He is dead—I am death!”

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Dice</titleLeft><mainText>Renekton can dash again to a location, dealing physical damage to enemies struck along his path.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Renekton dashes, dealing damage to units along the way. Empowered, Renekton deals bonus damage and reduces the Armor of units hit.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Renekton dashes, dealing @BasicDamage@ physical damage. He generates @MinionRageGeneration@ Fury per non-champion and @ChampionRageGeneration@ Fury per champion hit. Hitting at least one enemy allows Renekton to Recast this Ability once for @DiceTimer@ seconds.

Fury Bonus: The Recast dash deals @EmpDamage@ physical damage instead and removes @EnragedArmorShred@% Armor for @ShredTimer@ seconds. Does not generate Fury.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Armor Reduction</titleLeft><mainText>This unit's Armor has been reduced by an empowered Slice and Dice.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
